en.name: Color Palette from Photo
en.title: Color Palette from Photo: Extract HEX Codes and Send to Procreate (Free)
en.desc: Free color palette generator from any photo. Get 3 to 12 main colors with HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK codes, drag dots to fine-tune, send the palette to Procreate, copy CSS variables or download an Instagram-size card. Your photo never leaves your browser.
en.app_desc: Upload a photo to get its main colors as a palette, fine-tune by dragging dots on the image, and export to Procreate, CSS variables or a shareable card.
en.howto: How to make a color palette from a photo
